name: dsh-openclaw-weixin-bridge
description: 把微信（OpenClaw 微信通道）与 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桥接起来：DSH webhook 桥接插件 + OpenClaw hook pack + 微信通道运行时修复包 + 配置样例与文档。

scripts.check: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node scripts/check-config-samples.mjs && node scripts/scan-repo-hygiene.mjs --quiet-placeholders && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:hook-handler && npm run test:hook && npm run test:fix && npm run test:gate
